name: velcro-mcp-server
title: Velcro Crypto Settlement & Ramp Protocol
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for querying real-time crypto-fiat exchange rates, estimating transaction fees, and tracking order fulfillment on Velcro.

tools.name: get_exchange_rates
tools.description: Fetch live buy and sell rates in NGN for USDT, USDC, BTC, ETH, and SOL

currency.description: Optional coin symbol (USDT, USDC, BTC, ETH, SOL)

tools.name: calculate_quote
tools.description: Calculate exact fiat cost or crypto payout including fees

tools.name: track_order
tools.description: Query order status, blockchain transaction confirmation, and bank payout status

order_ref.description: The unique Velcro order reference code
